useCase.title: Reset password
basicFlow: The user selects "Forgot my password" on the sign-in page.
The system asks for the e-mail address of the account.
The user types the e-mail address and confirms.
The system sends a message with a reset link valid for 30 minutes.
The user opens the link and types a new password twice.
The system stores the new password and shows a confirmation.

exceptionFlow.condition: The e-mail address is not registered (step 3).
steps: The system shows the same confirmation as in the basic flow, without sending any message.

testCase.title: Reset request for an unregistered e-mail address
steps: Open the sign-in page and select "Forgot my password".
Type an e-mail address that has no account and confirm.
testCase.expected: The confirmation is shown and no message is sent.
